title: Rhyme and syllables
examples: Teacher, what words sound the same at the end?
How do I know how many beats are in a word?

explain.say: Words have beats. Each beat is called a syllable. You clap once for each beat.
Say apple and clap. Ap-ple has two beats. So you clap two times.
Say banana and clap. Ba-na-na has three beats. So you clap three times.
Now say your name. Clap each beat. Count your claps.
Words that rhyme sound the same at the end. Cat and mat rhyme. They both end in at.
Listen to dog, log and sun. Dog and log rhyme. Sun has a different end sound.

faq.a: A rhyming family is a group of words that sound the same at the end. For example, cup and pup belong to the -up family.

faq.q: How do I know how many syllables a word has?
faq.a: You clap the word out slowly. Each clap makes one syllable. For instance, el-e-phant has three claps.

faq.q: What does 'odd one out' mean in phonics?
faq.a: It means the one word that is different from the others. In a rhyme task, it is the word with a different end sound.

faq.q: Do all rhyming words have the same number of syllables?
faq.a: Not always, but often they do. For example, rain and pain both have one syllable. This helps us guess the rhyming word.
asks: Must they have the same beats?

faq.q: If I say 'table', how many syllables is that?
faq.a: You would clap ta-ble. That is two claps. So the word table has two syllables.

facts: Rhyming words have matching ending sounds.
A syllable is one beat or one sound in a word.
Clapping is a good way to count syllables.
Rhyming families group words by their ending sound.

quiz.say: Say butterfly. Clap the beats. Tap how many claps.
quiz.why: But-ter-fly has three beats. So you clap three times.

wrong.0: Say it slowly, but-ter-fly, and you will hear one more beat.
wrong.2: Clap once for each beat: but-ter-fly.

quiz.say: Listen to bike. Tap the word that rhymes.
quiz.why: Bike and like both end with the same sound, ike.

wrong.0: Big starts with b too, but it ends with a g sound.
wrong.2: Bite ends with a t sound, and bike ends with a k sound.

quiz.say: Two words rhyme. Tap the word with a different end sound.
quiz.why: Tree and bee rhyme. Car ends with a different sound.

wrong.0: Tree rhymes with bee, because they both end in ee.
wrong.1: Bee rhymes with tree, because they both end in ee.
